entry.name: icon
entry.label: The name of the icon used in the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: menuLabel
entry.label: Text label for the Panel button

entry.name: appNameFormat
entry.label: The format used in the display of application names: 0 = NameOnly, 1 = GenericNameOnly, 2 = NameAndGenericName, 3 = GenericNameAndName

entry.name: favorites
entry.label: List of general favorites. Supported values are menu id's (usually .desktop file names), special URLs that expand into default applications (e.g. preferred://browser), document URLs and KPeople contact URIs.

entry.name: systemFavorites
entry.label: List of system action favorites.

entry.name: primaryActions
entry.label: Which actions should be displayed in the footer: 0 = Power, 1 = Session, 2 = Custom, 3 = Power and session

entry.name: favoritesPortedToKAstats
entry.label: Are the favorites ported to use KActivitiesStats to allow per-activity favorites

entry.name: systemApplications
entry.label: List of applications at the top of the "Computer" tab.

entry.name: paneSwap
entry.label: Whether to swap the sidebar and content panes

entry.name: favoritesDisplay
entry.label: How to display favorites: 0 = Grid, 1 = List

entry.name: applicationsDisplay
entry.label: How to display applications: 0 = Grid, 1 = List

entry.name: alphaSort
entry.label: Whether to sort menu contents alphabetically or use manual/system sort order.

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated

entry.name: showActionButtonCaptions
entry.label: Whether to display captions ("shut down", "log out", etc.) for the footer action buttons

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Whether to use a compact display style for list items

entry.name: switchCategoryOnHover
entry.label: Whether to allow switching category items on hover

entry.name: highlightNewlyInstalledApps
entry.label: Whether to highlight newly-installed applications

entry.name: showDescriptionsInline
entry.label: Whether to show application descriptions inline in Windows-like menu layout mode

entry.name: scrollWheelTabSwitching
entry.label: Whether scrolling the mouse wheel over the footer tabs switches between Applications and Places

entry.name: classicStartAllPrograms
entry.label: Whether to start in All Programs view instead of Favorites in classic mode

entry.name: exposedThemeResponsive
entry.label: Whether the exposed (XP) menu style follows the system color scheme instead of the fixed Luna palette

entry.name: exposedSleepButton
entry.label: Whether the exposed (XP) footer zzz button suspends instead of hibernating

entry.name: classicThemeResponsive
entry.label: Whether the classic (Win9x) menu style follows the system color scheme instead of the fixed Windows Classic palette

entry.name: classicSideTitlebar
entry.label: Show a Windows 98 style vertical side titlebar on the left edge of the classic menu

entry.name: arrowThemeResponsive
entry.label: Whether the arrow (Win7) menu style follows the system color scheme instead of Aero colorization

entry.name: arrowTransparent
entry.label: Whether the arrow (Win7) chrome is translucent like Aero glass instead of opaque

entry.name: arrowAeroColor
entry.label: Index of the Windows 7 Aero color preset used by the arrow menu style

entry.name: metropolisAccent
entry.label: Preset color for the Metropolis sidebar and panel button

entry.name: groupProgramsByCategory
entry.label: Group All Programs using the KDE application categories

entry.name: groupWine
entry.label: Group Wine applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupDevelopment
entry.label: Group Development applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupEducation
entry.label: Group Education applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupGames
entry.label: Group Games applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupGraphics
entry.label: Group Graphics applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupInternet
entry.label: Group Internet applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupMultimedia
entry.label: Group Multimedia applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupOffice
entry.label: Group Office applications in All Programs

entry.name: groupScience
entry.label: Group Science applications in All Programs

entry.name: showLinuxTools
entry.label: Show the Linux Tools folder

entry.name: programEdits
entry.label: Start Bay shortcut names, folders, and placement overrides

entry.name: programOrder
entry.label: Manual order of application and folder IDs keyed by category

entry.name: classicShutdownAction
entry.label: The default shutdown action in classic mode (e.g. shutdown, reboot, suspend, hibernate, logout, lock)
